preconditions: Inventory deployed type/width and all values; confirm migration 137 lineage and backups.
backup: Restorable DB snapshot plus rehearsal; preserve journal rows and values.
forward: Reviewed additive/compatible width or constrained enum change; exact SQL DISCOVERY REQUIRED.
backfill: No history rewrite expected; verify every existing entry_type fits and classify unexpected values.
validation: Insert every domain type in isolated DB; compare row counts and journal/GL totals.
locking: Measure table lock and deployment compatibility.
rollback: Rollback may be unsafe after longer values are written; document rollback window and avoid truncation.
forward_correction: Keep widened schema and correct domain validation; never shorten/truncate posted history.

preconditions: Map source transaction boundaries; inspect deployed schema, duplicates and event-volume estimate.
backup: Restorable snapshot and restore test before adding tables/indexes.
forward: Add tables/indexes additively; exact schema DISCOVERY REQUIRED and ADR approval.
backfill: Backfill only source references that can be proven; unresolved events enter exception register, no guessed identities.
validation: Counts, uniqueness, sample event-to-journal reconciliation and dual-run parity before switch.
locking: Online/concurrent index strategy review and bounded batch backfill.
rollback: Do not drop event history after writes; disable dispatch only with durable queue preserved.
forward_correction: Replay idempotently or compensate; preserve source and posted journals.

preconditions: Accountant approves currencies, exponents, max values and rounding; inventory all columns/API formats.
backup: Snapshot and restore rehearsal; representative min/max and historical amount export.
forward: Expand precision or add canonical fields only after compatibility proof; exact tables/columns DISCOVERY REQUIRED.
backfill: Lossless conversion only; report rows that exceed scale/range and block cutover.
validation: Independent row sums, min/max, null counts and report/journal reconciliation by tenant/period.
locking: Benchmark rewrite and locks; use staged column/backfill if table rewrite is unsafe.
rollback: Legacy conversion may be irreversible if new-scale values are written; feature-gate and preserve old representation.
forward_correction: Keep precise representation and resolve exceptions with approved adjustment, never round-trip truncate.
